def: properly, to gape, i.e. snap at; figuratively, to overwhelm

occurrences.text: And I will put enmity between thee and the woman, and between thy seed and her seed; it shall bruise thy head, and thou shalt bruise his heel.
For he breaketh me with a tempest, and multiplieth my wounds without cause.
If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
